authorization.training: 用户明确要求：可以，请你开始训练。此前已确认同结构白噪声去噪器及其配套分类器。
authorization.latest_order: 相位已完成；去噪器200轮 → 配套分类器100轮 → 两者完成核验并退出后，自动运行同一主SNR的场景0–999与六档SNR，共6000次白噪声GP-MP推断。

prerequisite.on_failed_or_stopped: Notify the author and retain the queue; do not start training or alter the phase experiment.

denoiser.initialization: Recovered initializer is byte-identical to the colored run's historical random initializer; see INITIALIZATION_RECOVERY.json.
denoiser.only_scientific_training_change: noise.max_strength: 0.5 -> 0.0, retaining covariance-conditioned architecture, preconditioning, clean data, noise powers, random streams, optimizer, EMA, training budget and selection rule.

classifier.start_after: Denoiser completes all 200 epochs and its process exits; verify complete.json and selected weight hash.
classifier.binding: After denoiser completion, copy the base configuration to the independent new configuration. Replace output, first checkpoint/record paths and their actual SHA256 values. Update objective/scope/differences to identify the frozen white-preconditioned teacher. Preserve all classifier scientific settings, random initialization, data, seeds, balanced BCE, noise support, C=vI queries and checkpoint selection. Retain and verify existing protected assets. The selected denoiser is frozen.
classifier.execution: Reuse the supported configurable original trainer; the existing colored classifier later used a validated prefetch continuation. Do not change mathematical batches, precision or optimization to obtain speed.

launch_and_monitor.on_training_failure_or_pause: Preserve checkpoint/logs; report once; no automatic retry, budget changes or early-stop rule changes.

interpretation.required_comparison: GP-MP (matched white) versus CGP-MP (colored): same evaluation inputs and C=vI queries, architecture, variance-estimation rule, classifier-training procedure and receiver settings. Independent denoising isolates the training intervention. Recomputed derivative variance and matched classifier training are downstream effects of the denoiser intervention.
interpretation.null_gain: No observed CGP-MP advantage over matched white GP-MP does not assign all STMP-to-CGP-MP gains to neural architecture. STMP differs in denoiser parameterization, variance-estimation method, damping and query-variance update. The main SNR comparison shares basic minimum/maximum iterations and tolerance, while CGP-MP additionally checks the variance-update residual. Account for paired uncertainty and retain unfavorable results.

evaluation.disable_followup_after: White evaluation verified and independent SBL CPU branch completed or failure/pause notified.
